newItemSeedGrade.note: Seeds required FSRS memory for an unseen curated item as Good while leaving it immediately due. This compatibility default has no chess-specific validation.

freshWindowHours.note: Recall of plans and intent decays fast; within roughly a day a player can still retrieve them without hints. Extrapolated from spacing and recency findings; no chess-specific study sets this window.

recentWindowDays.note: Past about a week, free recall of a game is unreliable, so prompts shift from recall to recognition. Extrapolated boundary, not a measured chess result.

prompt.value: Walk me through your thinking. What was your plan, and where did you feel you lost control of the game?
prompt.note: Retrieval-first prompting before the engine shows anything. The exact wording is untested product copy.

prompt.value: What do you remember about how this game went? Name anything that comes back before we look at the moves.
prompt.note: Free recall attempt before recognition aids appear. The exact wording is untested product copy.

prompt.value: Glance over the game details, then tell me whatever you remember about this game, even if it is only the result.
prompt.note: Recognition from metadata after memory has likely faded. The exact wording is untested product copy.
